Introduction 1.1 General The Stream Server (StrSvr) is a generic infrastructure component which can be used to provide streams of data over OpenAccess conforming to either the Reliable DataStream (RDS) or Transaction protocol. When providing an RDS feed, StrSvr acts as a server, accepting incoming connections from a client and supplying data depending on requests sent by that client. When providing a transaction stream, StrSvr connects to a transaction server and sends in transactions as defined by the configuration. Both streams can be recovered or resumed in the manner defined by the OpenAccess Programmer’s Guide. The following summarises the key features of each stream as implemented by StrSvr. 1.2 RDS • A resumable stream of data, generated by scanning a configured combination of relationally joined tables. • Provided in batches.
